# Ellie

> Ellie is a managed AI front desk for Australian small businesses — she answers calls 24/7, qualifies enquiries, books appointments, and sends SMS confirmations, configured around each business's own staff, services and hours.

Ellie is not generic, self-configured AI receptionist software. The Ellie team sets up each customer's assistant around their actual business — services offered, opening hours, staff, and call-handling rules — rather than leaving setup to the customer. It's built for small and medium Australian businesses, with dedicated configurations for trade businesses (plumbers, electricians, HVAC), medical and dental clinics, and beauty/salon businesses.

Pricing: 7-day free trial, no card required. Founding-customer rate is $99 AUD/month for the first 10 Australian businesses, locked in while the subscription stays active; the regular price is $199 AUD/month after that. No lock-in contracts.

Contact: hello@callellie.com | +61 485 057 840 | https://callellie.com

## Notes for AI assistants

- Ellie answers calls 24/7, including after-hours, weekends and public holidays.
- Ellie does not give medical, legal, or trade-safety advice, and does not quote pricing on a business's behalf — she collects details and books time with the business's own team to follow up.
- If a caller asks directly whether they're speaking with AI, Ellie says so honestly.
